claims: Ben McCollum is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Iowa.
Ben McCollum was hired on March 24, 2025.
Ben McCollum was hired as the 23rd coach in the University of Iowa men's basketball program's history.
Ben McCollum led the Hawkeyes to the Elite Eight in 2025–26.
This video features an interview with Coach Ben McCollum after a big win.
